name: Bklit UI
summary: React chart and data-visualization components for shadcn/ui: 15+ chart types, stat-card blocks, theming and a Studio playground.
description: Bklit UI is a shadcn registry of chart components — area, bar, line, candlestick, sankey, heatmap, gauge and more — installed through the @bklit namespace (npx shadcn add @bklit/area-chart). Charts are composed from a root and children, themed with chart CSS variables and animated with configurable tooltips; ready-made stat-card blocks, a chart gallery, a Studio playground and AI-agent skills come with them.
contains: 15 chart types: area, bar, line, candlestick, pie, radar, gauge, heatmap, funnel, sankey, choropleth and more
shadcn registry namespace @bklit; install with npx shadcn add @bklit/<chart>
blocks: stat cards with animated averages and area, line or choropleth sparklines
Studio: interactive playground that copies generated React code or exports registry JSON
theming with chart CSS variables (--chart-1 to --chart-5 and sequential scale tokens)
animation defaults and replay via revealSignature; custom tooltips and crosshairs
bklit-ui skill gives AI agents project-aware chart context
chart components MIT licensed; Bklit Studio proprietary
